topology_authority: Exact saved text coordinates govern; generated plans are not survey drawings. HQ00 was used only as its own correction target, never as a room-generation reference.
copy_verification: All PNG hashes, prompts, receipts and QA files match their project copies.

issues.finding: R&D room insets/cutaways contain cat silhouettes inside chambers despite explicit empty-set requirement.
CEO panel contains Barkington portrait despite no-portraits instruction.
Plan omits A/B camera marks and directions; rendered hall elevator doors appear directly on corridor, unlike dedicated-suite doorway topology.
A/B are indicated diagonally in plan, while rendered wides are closer to centered axes; use as design views rather than precise lens/blocking plates.
Floor detail introduces a paw medallion not specified as a fixed floor feature; choose whether it is floor or tabletop material detail before scene plates.
Reverse B is centered on south edge with a northward arrow rather than specified southwest/northeast diagonal. Render and adjusted plan agree broadly but differ from exact written camera coordinate.
Benches subdivide into two units on each side elevation while plan simplifies each side; lock exact module counts before close coverage.

issues.note: Plan perimeter symbols along the south edge resemble window segments despite the south wall render being solid; treat south wall as opaque per text and rendered wall.
Plan camera arrows and fixture placement are approximate rather than survey-grade coordinates.
Hero A shows the north entry as the far wall although A should look southwest to the south cabinets. Do not use hero A as the approved camera angle.
Reverse B shows north entry but mirrors east workbench to screen-left and west chambers to screen-right. The wall views and text coordinate map govern.
Plan north door is near center; authoritative north entry is x9 within 12m width (three-quarters from west).
South-facing hero shows west rack screen-left and east cabinet screen-right, mirrored relative to the text, plan and reverse. Correct hero side fixtures before using it for scene continuity.
A/B wide compositions are nearly axial instead of the stated diagonal camera coordinates.
Both wide views mirror the east reader: hero facing south shows it screen-right and reverse facing north shows it screen-left. Correct reader wall in wides.

Open north entry looks into a long north-south corridor. The master requires the east-west hall immediately beyond the entrance; replace that background with the across-hall wall/sideways circulation.
Plan vestibule/shaft visual length ratio is approximate despite correct printed6m/12m dimensions.
Small north-wall console is omitted from the floor-plan drawing although consistently present in north elevation and reverse.
Wide camera positions are approximate and the north entry appears slightly off-center in elevation; text coordinates control precise blocking.
Plan pool table sits nearer room center than the specified southern placement y29; use exact text coordinates during production modeling.
Blank south-wall display is visible in elevations/reverse but omitted from plan symbol coverage.

North-up plan incorrectly copies the south-facing elevation's screen order: south labels left-to-right ELEVATORS, SECURITY, LOBBY, SERVER, R&D. In the north-up plan these must instead be R&D, SERVER, LOBBY, SECURITY, ELEVATORS at x9,17,27,36,44. Correct labels and their identities before any route blocking.
Elevator access is rendered as a lift-style door directly on corridor rather than a normal entrance into the dedicated elevator vestibule. Use the master suite connection, not a direct third lift.
Door spacing and number visible in hero are approximate; OFFICE x7 is behind camera A x8 and must not be moved forward into that view.
